I1.quote: Searched main text and SI for any H2 uptake from the gas phase (gravimetric, volumetric, Sieverts, flow, TPD, hydrogen, sorption, storage, uptake). Not found. The only gas adsorption is N2 for surface area and pore size (main Fig. 1f; SI: "The nitrogen absorption-desorption isotherms were measured using the equipment of Micromeritics 3Flex"). The measurements are OER/ORR electrocatalysis, Zn-air battery tests and DFT; "hydrogen" appears only as the reversible hydrogen electrode (RHE) reference and hydrogen peroxide.

I5.quote: Both oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) play a vital role in renewable energy conversion and storage technologies, such as rechargeable metal-air batteries [1–4] and fuel cells [5,6].

notes: Paper is an oxygen-electrocatalysis study (Co-CoO nanoparticles in N,S-doped carbon from thiourea-ZIF-67; OER/ORR in KOH, Zn-air batteries, DFT). No H2 uptake of any kind. Code is no_conditions_stated by the I1-failure rule: the work is experimental, so not theoretical_only, and its electrochemistry is of oxygen, not hydrogen (no hydrogen charging, no HER), so not electrochemical. The article carries the journal section label "Perspective" on page 1, but it reports original synthesis, characterization and electrochemical data with an SI experimental section, so not_primary was not applied. record.json is_retracted is false and no retraction notice appears in the text. I2 to I4 not assessed per instruction (N2 BET/BJH surface areas exist but concern no H2 uptake).
